result:
Fixed in `strip_reminders` (`anthrouter/request_text.py`), which is the root cause. Its docstring promised to trim outer whitespace, but it didn't. Stripping the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed. I added `.strip()` to its return value.

Your example input now returns `True`. Every other caller of `strip_reminders` also gets the trimmed text, as the docstring said it would.

I couldn't run the test suite: `pytest` isn't installed, and `make test` fails because there's no `python` on the PATH. So I haven't checked whether any existing test relied on the untrimmed output.
